S1294.reason: Molecular oxygen is consumed by peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase in fatty-acid conversion to acetyl-CoA, while glycolysis, the TCA cycle, and glycogenolysis do not use O2.

S1272.reason: An honest good-faith dispute over the amount due is consideration for an accord and satisfaction, so the $35,000 settlement is valid even though the contractor had fully performed.

S0628.reason: ICJ Statute Article 38 treats treaties, custom, and general principles as the formal sources; judicial decisions are only subsidiary means and GA resolutions are not formal sources.
